subject: [PATCH v4 08/21] ntfs: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations for NTFS to use the new ->iomap_next() callback. The conversion is done using macros that wrap the iomap_iter_next() helper to finish previous mappings and produce the next one. No functional changes are intended, making this a refactoring patch. It affects several functions in fs/ntfs/iomap.c, including ntfs_read_iomap_begin, ntfs_zero_read_iomap_end, ntfs_seek_iomap_begin, and others. The conversion is done to align with the new iomap API and improve code consistency.
